name: agentfleet
description: A hosted control plane for remote Codex sessions on trusted Linux, macOS, and Windows machines.

scripts.build: npm run build:control-plane && npm run build:web && npm run build:local-agent
scripts.check: npm --prefix apps/control-plane run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm --prefix apps/local-agent run check
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/control-plane test && npm --prefix apps/local-agent test && npm --prefix apps/web test
